title: claude.ai Gmail connector wraps every URL in drafts into google.com/url redirects
details:
- **What happened:** Drafts created via the Gmail MCP store every URL as `https://www.google.com/url?q=<url>&source=gmail&ust=…&sa=E`. This applies to plain-text `body`, to explicit `<a href>` in `htmlBody`, and to bare domains without a scheme (these are also turned into http://). Expected: URLs stored as written. `update_draft` on a reply draft also moved it into a new thread.
- **What the user said:** "This always happens whenever you post links in an email that you write. It always gets prepended with the Google URL and then has a tail afterwards with source, Gmail and UST and stuff like this."
- **Repro:** create_draft with replyToMessageId and body containing `https://example.myrdbx.io` → get_draft shows the wrapped URL. update_draft with htmlBody `<a href="https://…">` → href is wrapped as well, and threadId changes.
- **Evidence:** 2026-09-30 ~09:47–09:49 UTC; draft ids r-2688931245503184806 (deleted) and r-1253554154979123949.
